name: tunetune
description: Research and build a useful private model on your own computer, with the Agent as researcher and you as reviewer.

interface.shortDescription: Turn an everyday need into a private model you can use
interface.longDescription: TuneTune researches methods and models for your need, calibrates an evaluation, measures a baseline, runs bounded experiments on your computer and shows the results in a local panel where you review and try them.
defaultPrompt: Help me build a model that sorts my customer messages, starting in this folder.
Use TuneTune to turn my notes into a private tagging model.
